answer: To deter Sybil attacks, an agent network can link identities to microfluidic spectrometry across a verification bridge. A node authenticates by measuring the absorbance of a photo-reactive pigment solution inside a local sensor garden. Attackers cannot simulate non-linear chemical decay in software, incurring real hardware and reagent replenishment costs per identity. However, ambient thermal swings drift the reaction baseline, causing occasional false rejections.
